title: CI evidence report generators retain fifteen SonarQube Cloud cognitive-complexity findings and one duplicate block
title_de: CI-Evidence-Reportgeneratoren bewahren fünfzehn SonarQube-Cloud-Cognitive-Complexity-Befunde und einen Duplikatblock
protocol: Parent CI evidence report generation and runtime-evidence classification
profile: Baseline SonarQube Cloud master analysis 3b1a67b0-1026-4dbc-a437-192604db29b4 at caabf33c11d6002f9a1661f215ed195d6e141253; verified resulting-master analysis 9d61b075-9f49-48f2-b74f-c8a0d8e68f9f at 6dc912643133e5c7d3c305979d4052da9cb45153
summary: The revision-bound current-master SonarQube Cloud inventory contained fifteen OPEN CRITICAL python:S3776 code-smell receipts in Parent ci/evidence report generators and one 23-line duplicate block between two report-generator CLI entry points. Protected PR #225 exact head 74bcb950f8a75835b4fb59175a783e9aedcfd1c3 was normally merged as resulting master 6dc912643133e5c7d3c305979d4052da9cb45153. All 14 exact-master GitHub Actions workflows passed; the original fifteen keys are CLOSED/FIXED, and the targeted ci/evidence component now has zero violations and zero duplicated lines. The global master Quality Gate remains ERROR solely on the pre-existing new-security-rating baseline tracked by FND-SONAR-0001 and is not attributed to this remediation. The finding is verified, not closed.
summary_de: Das revisionsgebundene Current-Master-SonarQube-Cloud-Inventar enthielt fünfzehn OPEN-CRITICAL-python:S3776-Code-Smell-Receipts in Parent-CI-Evidence-Reportgeneratoren und einen 23-Zeilen-Duplikatblock zwischen zwei CLI-Einstiegspunkten von Reportgeneratoren. Der geschützte exakte PR-#225-Head 74bcb950f8a75835b4fb59175a783e9aedcfd1c3 wurde normal als Resulting Master 6dc912643133e5c7d3c305979d4052da9cb45153 gemergt. Alle 14 Exact-Master-GitHub-Actions-Workflows bestanden; die ursprünglichen fünfzehn Keys sind CLOSED/FIXED, und die ausgewählte ci/evidence-Komponente besitzt nun null Violations und null Duplikatzeilen. Das globale Master-Quality-Gate bleibt ausschließlich wegen der bereits bestehenden New-Security-Rating-Baseline unter FND-SONAR-0001 ERROR und wird dieser Remediation nicht zugeschrieben. Das Finding ist verified, nicht closed.
observed_behavior: At master revision caabf33c11d6002f9a1661f215ed195d6e141253, the selected ci/evidence component reports 15 OPEN python:S3776 findings with cognitive complexity from 16 through 33 where 15 is allowed. The component also reports 23 duplicated lines (0.1%), traced to equivalent final-audit and rule-chain command-line lifecycle scaffolding.
observed_behavior_de: Auf der Master-Revision caabf33c11d6002f9a1661f215ed195d6e141253 meldet die ausgewählte ci/evidence-Komponente 15 OPEN-python:S3776-Findings mit einer kognitiven Komplexität von 16 bis 33 bei erlaubten 15. Die Komponente meldet außerdem 23 duplizierte Zeilen (0,1 %), die auf gleichwertiges Final-Audit- und Rule-Chain-Command-Line-Lifecycle-Scaffolding zurückgeführt wurden.
expected_behavior: Report generators keep their existing schemas, ordering, path containment, redaction, classification precedence, and fail-closed runtime-evidence rules while their independent data collection, decision, rendering, and post-write responsibilities are kept below the Sonar cognitive-complexity threshold. The two entry points share the established safe lifecycle without a duplicate scaffold.
expected_behavior_de: Reportgeneratoren behalten ihre bestehenden Schemas, Reihenfolge, Path-Containment, Redaktion, Klassifizierungspräzedenz und fail-closed Runtime-Evidence-Regeln, während ihre unabhängigen Datensammlungs-, Entscheidungs-, Rendering- und Post-Write-Verantwortlichkeiten unter dem Sonar-Cognitive-Complexity-Schwellenwert bleiben. Die beiden Einstiegspunkte teilen den etablierten sicheren Lifecycle ohne dupliziertes Scaffolding.
impact: The issue is a maintainability backlog within evidence tooling, but its functions handle path-constrained output, report serialization, state classification, and runtime-evidence interpretation. An unsafe simplification could weaken a real integrity boundary. There is no demonstrated security defect, no scanner-control change, and no claim about the global project backlog.
impact_de: Der Befund ist ein Maintainability-Backlog innerhalb der Evidence-Tooling, aber seine Funktionen behandeln pfadbegrenzte Ausgabe, Report-Serialisierung, State-Klassifizierung und Runtime-Evidence-Interpretation. Eine unsichere Vereinfachung könnte eine echte Integritätsgrenze schwächen. Es gibt keinen nachgewiesenen Security-Defekt, keine Scanner-Control-Änderung und keine Aussage über den globalen Projekt-Backlog.

root_cause: Several evidence report generators accumulated parsing, evidence filtering, status classification, rendering, and output-lifecycle responsibilities in single functions. Two independent CLI entry points also retained equivalent lifecycle scaffolding.
root_cause_de: Mehrere Evidence-Reportgeneratoren sammelten Parsing-, Evidence-Filter-, Statusklassifizierungs-, Rendering- und Output-Lifecycle-Verantwortlichkeiten in einzelnen Funktionen. Zwei unabhängige CLI-Einstiegspunkte bewahrten zudem gleichwertiges Lifecycle-Scaffolding.
proposed_remediation: Extract narrow, behavior-preserving helpers around the existing report contracts; preserve output-root setup and fail-closed evidence predicates; invoke the final-audit post-write step through the established safe lifecycle; and add regression tests for changed ordering, fallback, classification, retention, and negative evidence cases. Create one Parent Draft PR and obtain exact-head hosted SonarQube Cloud verification. Do not change scanner controls or merely move code to alter metrics.
proposed_remediation_de: Enge verhaltensbewahrende Helper um die bestehenden Report-Verträge extrahieren; Output-Root-Setup und fail-closed Evidence-Prädikate bewahren; den Final-Audit-Post-Write-Schritt durch den etablierten sicheren Lifecycle aufrufen; und Regressionstests für geänderte Reihenfolge, Fallback, Klassifizierung, Retention und negative Evidence-Fälle ergänzen. Einen Parent-Draft-PR erstellen und Exact-Head-Hosted-SonarQube-Cloud-Verifikation einholen. Scanner-Controls nicht ändern und Code nicht bloß zur Metrikänderung verschieben.
acceptance_criteria: Every retained issue key and the duplicate block has a concrete source-level disposition in the task-owned diff; no selected ci/evidence item is silently omitted.
Focused source, schema, ordering, safe-output, path-normalization, and fail-closed evidence controls pass without changing a SonarQube Cloud control or an unrelated repository boundary.
A focused post-change security diff review finds no reportable diff-induced security finding.
The exact task-owned PR head reports zero OPEN/CONFIRMED SonarQube Cloud new issues and zero New-Code duplication, with a passing Quality Gate, without any scanner-control change.

The resulting-master SonarQube Cloud analysis is read after the separately authorized integration; the original keys and component duplication must no longer reproduce before setting verified or closed.
validation_plan: Run Python compilation for every changed source and direct test, the focused report/evidence unittest aggregate, and git diff --check.
Run the legitimate safe-output, runtime-path, generated-report-integrity, and fail-closed XML decision controls included in the selected suites.
Perform a complete focused security diff review of the changed evidence/report sources and direct tests.
Before delivery, repeat remote identity preflight, inspect the final task-owned diff, scan only staged task files for secrets, and verify local/remote/PR-head SHA equality.
Read exact-head GitHub Actions and SonarQube Cloud results after PR analysis is complete; do not treat an earlier or base analysis as proof.
legitimate_control_tests: HAProxy XML decision-evidence negative cases for duplicate, disruptive, and non-empty match records
